design_summary: Synthesizable FPGA top-level for an intelligent active-aerodynamics controller using a PicoRV32/Wishbone soft CPU subsystem, a firmware-visible CSR/MMIO register bank, a bounded 64-bit model transport bridge, safety supervision, timeout handling, safe fallback, and clamped actuator command generation. The design intentionally does not implement the surrogate model compute in RTL.

fixed_assumptions: External model runtime is off-chip software/GPU and communicates only through the bounded valid/ready model transport interface.
All RTL is vendor-agnostic synthesizable logic; no Sky130 hard macros are used in the FPGA path.
The top-level module name is exactly adaptive_aero_control_top.
The CPU integration contract is preserved as PicoRV32 on Wishbone at 50 MHz with ilp32/rv32imc semantics in firmware handoff metadata.

top_module.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
top_module.description: Top-level integration for the PicoRV32/Wishbone firmware control plane, firmware-visible CSR/MMIO register bank, bounded model transport, safety supervision, and clamped actuator command path.
top_module.functionality: Top-level controller that exposes Wishbone access to the PicoRV32 subsystem, firmware-visible CSR/MMIO registers, and bounded model transport to an external runtime. It integrates register decode, request framing, response validation, timeout supervision, safe fallback, and command clamping to produce a deterministic actuator command.
responsibilities: Drive all external outputs directly from RTL.
Fan out clock and reset to synchronous submodules.
Bridge Wishbone/CPU-side control to the firmware-visible CSR/MMIO registers.
Emit bounded model requests and receive bounded model responses.
Enforce safety supervision, timeout, sequence checking, and clamp behavior.
Expose deterministic status and fault signaling.
Ensure no top-level output is driven only by a child input.
top_module.reset_behavior: On reset, the top-level drives safe command behavior, clears outstanding request state, clears fault summary bits, deasserts request-valid and output-valid, and asserts safe fallback until firmware arms the system.
behavior_rules: Every top-level output must have a real RTL driver.
Top-level transport direction follows the mandatory contract: request valid/data are outputs with ready input; response valid/data are inputs with ready output.
The firmware MMIO interface shall be real and reachable by RTL decode.
Model request sequence numbers and message-length checking shall be handled in hardware.
Any fault causes safe fallback and deterministic command output.
No combinational loop may exist between transport inputs and actuator outputs.

modules.name: picorv32_wb_subsystem
modules.description: PicoRV32-based soft CPU subsystem on Wishbone, providing firmware execution and access to the application MMIO window.
modules.functionality: Instantiates the resolved PicoRV32-based CPU contract and Wishbone-facing firmware execution environment. It generates MMIO transactions toward the application register block and returns read data and ready/acknowledge responses. It does not implement the application control logic itself.
responsibilities: Provide the CPU-side Wishbone and MMIO bridge interface.
Generate firmware-visible register transactions.
Consume MMIO read data and ready/acknowledge responses.
Remain synchronous to the top-level clock and reset.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset the CPU subsystem and clear any pending bus activity.
behavior_rules: All CPU-facing bus signals are explicit ports.
The subsystem may be synthesized with CPU memories and interconnect only as part of the soft CPU subsystem.
No application model payload storage is implemented here.

modules.name: aero_control_register_bank
modules.description: Firmware-visible CSR/MMIO register bank implementing the application control-plane registers, status registers, and clearable fault bits.
modules.functionality: Implements the described 32-bit firmware-visible control-plane register window. It decodes writes and reads, presents configuration outputs to the control bridge, and returns status and fault metadata to firmware. It performs real register decode for every declared register and field.
responsibilities: Provide a real MMIO register decode path reachable from top-level address/write-data/read-data/valid/write-enable/ready signals.
Expose configuration fields for enable, launch, clear_faults, mode, firmware_fault, velocity, clamp bounds, request metadata, timeout, and status/fault reporting.
Return read data for every implemented register and field.
Drive clearable control outputs to the transport/safety logic.
Capture response/status fields from the bridge and present them to firmware.
Do not claim any inaccessible internal state as software-visible.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset all registers to safe fallback defaults, clear pending launch state, and present fault/fallback status consistent with reset.
behavior_rules: Every declared register in register_contract must be reachable by decode.
No register may be described as software-visible unless it is actually implemented and decoded.
CSR/MMIO interface semantics must include ready/response behavior.
Status outputs may be registered levels or one-cycle pulses, but must be deterministic.

modules.name: model_transport_bridge
modules.description: Bounded 64-bit valid/ready transport bridge that frames compact model requests and validates compact model responses with sequence and length checks.
modules.functionality: Frames compact outbound model requests, attaches sequence numbers, monitors outstanding request state, accepts compact inbound responses, validates response sequence and encoding, detects stale or repeated responses, monitors timeout expiration, and produces clamped actuator commands with safe fallback on any fault.
responsibilities: Generate a bounded-width request frame no wider than 64 bits.
Attach and increment sequence numbers for each accepted request.
Only accept new requests when idle and previous request has retired.
Validate inbound response sequence against the outstanding request sequence.
Detect malformed response payload length or encoding and assert fault_malformed_o.
Detect stale, repeated, or late response conditions and assert fault_stale_o.
Detect timeout expiration and assert fault_timeout_o.
Clamp actuator commands to configured minimum and maximum values and assert clamp status when clamping occurs.
Force safe fallback after reset or any fault and provide deterministic command output.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset to idle-safe state, clear outstanding request state and counters, deassert request-valid and output-valid, and assert safe fallback until armed.
behavior_rules: The bridge shall have deterministic synchronous one-cycle or registered behavior.
No combinational loop may exist between response ingress and actuator output.
No tensors, arrays, geometry buffers, or flow-field outputs are exposed.
The bridge only handles compact request/response transport and small state, not bulk payload memory.
